incident: payments-worker crashed after both a memory increase and a recent deployment

memory_history.summary: Memory rose from 52% to 91% before the crash, but did not reach the configured 95% limit.

deployment_history.summary: Version 2.8.1 was deployed 12 minutes before the crash; the change modified request batching.

host_events.summary: No operating-system OOM kill was recorded for the host during the incident window.
